title: Arrays

> **Curriculum:** This chapter follows [LEARN-LANGUAGES/CURRICULUM.md](../../CURRICULUM.md). Exercise ids are shared across LEARN-* repos for cross-reference.

## Arrays in C#

Use **`int[]`**, **`Span<T>`**, and LINQ (`string.Join`) when you need stable, human-readable formatting for automated stdout checks.

exercises.title: Create array
exercises.description: Create `[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]` and print it with Debug formatting.

exercises.title: Iterate array
exercises.description: Create `[10, 20, 30]` and print each element on its own line.

exercises.title: Partial initialization
exercises.description: Create `[10, 20, 0, 0, 0]` using `[10, 20, 0, 0, 0]` literal and print Debug.

exercises.title: 2D array
exercises.description: Print `1`, `2`, `3`, `4` each on its own line from `[[1,2],[3,4]]`.

exercises.title: Index access
exercises.description: From `[100, 200, 300]` print first and last with spaces.
